blogs.title: Rhabdomyolysis vs. Myopathy: When a 'Simple' Muscle Injury Needs Immunosuppression
blogs.description: This post explores the critical clinical distinction between drug-induced rhabdomyolysis and immune-mediated necrotising myopathy (IMNM). While many clinicians are trained to look for rapid CK resolution upon drug withdrawal, this case highlights a delayed, progressive presentation that requires aggressive intervention. We discuss the temporal markers, clinical nuances, and why 'watchful waiting' can be dangerous in cases of true necrotising myopathy.

blogs.title: The GLP-1 Revolution and the New Frontier of Adverse Effects
blogs.description: As GLP-1 receptor agonists like semaglutide become cornerstones of metabolic medicine, clinicians must remain vigilant for emerging rare toxicities. This post analyzes the shift from expected side effects (GI upset and muscle mass loss) to potential immune-mediated complications. We discuss the importance of pharmacovigilance and what specific red flags should prompt a rheumatology consult in a patient on these high-profile medications.

blogs.title: Navigating the 'Seronegative' Maze in Immune-Mediated Myopathy
blogs.description: Not every patient with necrotising myopathy will test positive for anti-HMGCR or anti-SRP antibodies. This post focuses on the diagnostic challenge of seronegative IMNM, emphasizing the role of muscle biopsy in providing a definitive diagnosis. We discuss how to interpret histological findings like macrophage infiltration and membrane attack complex positivity when the standard myositis panel comes back negative.

blogs.title: Diagnostic Confounders: Sorting NAFLD, Stress, and Muscle Breakdown
blogs.description: In patients with metabolic syndrome, laboratory results can be messy. This case featured elevated transaminases, cardiac markers, and a history of NAFLD. We discuss how to differentiate primary hepatosteatosis from elevated enzymes secondary to muscle breakdown, and how to approach inconclusive cardiac MRI findings in the context of systemic inflammatory myopathy.

blogs.title: Aggressive Intervention: When to Escalate to IVIG and Pulse Steroids
blogs.description: The management of IMNM often requires a delicate balance between rapid treatment and cautious monitoring. This post reviews the clinical triggers for initiating high-dose corticosteroids and IVIG, particularly in cases of severe proximal weakness and dysphagia. We also touch upon the prognosis for drug-induced myopathy compared to idiopathic variants.
